subject: LAB-017
check: Hosted clean replay and reopening materialization qualification
steps: Through labr: LabPhone-Core test -only-testing:LabPhoneTests/DurableSyncQualificationHostTests on a ticket-created iOS simulator
Fresh confined root; save both offline notes; reconnect and inspect conflict; choose North count and reconnect; repeat stale choice; disable profile and observe refusal
Export/reset/import twice and compare export bytes; delete/export/reset/import tombstone; verify a user-owned sentinel file outside the demo root is byte-identical
Separately save an edit, export it, open a fresh session on the same root and compare export bytes and live state
Inspect xcresulttool summary and test nodes; temporary fixture folders removed by test cleanup; EXIT trap deletes only the simulator created by this run

outcome.detail: Test action Passed: 2 tests, 1 passed and 1 expected failure. Clean replay passed, including conflict choice, stale refusal, disabled-profile manual exchange, duplicate import, deletion, and external sentinel preservation. Reopening retained export bytes but failed the expected live-state assertion. The persisted applied markers prevent rebuilding into the new host in-memory store; the reopened live record is absent. This expected failure is a failed restoration check, not a successful persistence qualification. Smallest observed mismatch: reopened.selectedPane?.state was .absent, expected .live(title: "Field note", note: "Retained edit").

limitations: Hosted model calls only: no UI gestures, file-dialog dispatch, screenshot, accessibility audit or OS reinstall.
Local FileSyncProfile and DisabledSyncProfile; no CloudKit, live account change, entitlement or external service.
Simulator runtime iOS 27.0 (24A434), iPhone 18 Pro; not a physical iPhone or iPad.
Reset protection proves one original sentinel file outside the fixture root; documents imported into the demo root are intentionally cleared.
Input code is the qualification test source later committed as 787fcfb. No personal data or raw store is published.
